descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S08 Next day / next visit: deleted items do not come back; a re-dictated one does

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again. (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Day 1: Hospital patient with a pre-round Save Note that extracted a metoprolol row and a goals-of-care task, a manual point 'Check heel ulcer dressing', and seeded rows 'Metformin 500 mg PO BID' (held, 'NPO') and 'Tramadol 50 mg PO PRN' (stopped); all five deleted, then a note generated. …

When Age the chart about 20 h on the server (next server day / next visit) and process again: Save Note and Generate with text that does not name the deleted items. Then, as a positive control, dictate 'Restart metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID' and Save Note.

Then Day 2 summary, task list, points and note have none of the deleted items, including the held and stopped rows (the held-row refresh must not restore them, 3.6). After the re-dictation the metoprolol row is back (it was dictated again), and the note carries day 2's text. Same in Nursing Home on the next visit.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-24 bullet 3 + TFA-94699 AC 5. Deleted items absent from the day-2 summary, lists and note; positive controls from the day-2 text (oracleRules 1); the re-dictated row present. The next day is the server day (3.8); on main the day roll uses the device clock (known: TFA-92584).

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (manual)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S08

Next day / next visit: deleted items do not come back; a re-dictated one does

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane manual: status passed-partial in manual/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): chromium spec (partly). Day 1 seeded: metoprolol row + goals-of-care task + manual point + held metformin + stopped tramadol, all five deleted through the app's own write (rounding:update), then aged 20 h; day 2: real pre-round Save Note with the day-2 text (UI) — deleted items must not come back, 'ambulating' control present; then re-dictate 'Restart metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID' + Save Note → row back. Same in NH (visit 2). The Generate half not run (forbidden locally). Evidence files are prefixed with the part (hospital-*, nursing-home-*). — Save Note half runs; the generated-note half needs Generate (forbidden on the local stack).

Detail:

7/7 judged cells pass, 3 NOT RUN. Not run: day 1: Generate after the deletes (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json); dev only) | day 2: Generate with text that does not name the deleted items (note checked) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack; dev only) | next visit: Generate (note checked) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack; dev only).

During the run (runNote): Observation, not judged: the Hospital re-dictation 'Restart metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID.' through the pre-round Save Note also created an open task with that same text (evidence/TC-24-S08/hospital-redictated.json; seen in both runs). Evidence files are now prefixed with the part, so the Hospital and Nursing Home re-dictation evidence no longer overwrite each other.

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper and a server-clock control (stamps moved back about 20 h and the lifecycle re-run, through the local admin key); dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot move, so it stays on the local stack once the helper exists.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
